chat-small.what: the hosted assistant: chat-small with the long policy prompt and strict structured output (recorded in the evaluation course)

words.what: word counts + logistic regression for the team, the safety word list for needs_human (no language model)

base-policy.what: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct, a better prompt: the rules and three examples

base-choice.what: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct, the better prompt, answer chosen from the 10 valid answers

adapter.what: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct + the first LoRA adapter (runs/lora-r8, 2 epochs), the short instruction

adapter-long.what: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct + the second LoRA adapter (runs/lora-r8-long, 6 epochs), the short instruction
